title: ShieldVLM: Safeguarding the Multimodal Implicit Toxicity via Deliberative Reasoning with LVLMs
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Religion and Cultural Disrespect', 'Religion Discrimination', and 'Morality Violation' (which includes Professional Ethics and Public Morality) as core categories in its multimodal toxicity taxonomy and benchmarking dataset (MMIT-dataset). It evaluates the ability of models to detect these specific types of ethical and religious/cultural harms.
